invariants.rationale: The instantTime parameter is used directly and passed to Option.ofNullable and other methods, so it is likely expected to be non-null in typical usage.
The records parameter is used as input multiple times, including passed to Option.of and expected to be non-null for correct processing.
A non-trivial invariant about the input list: if records is not empty, then it must contain at least one element.
instantTime is used as a commit/operation identifier and likely expected to be non-empty and meaningful.
It's likely that the upsert operation expects all HoodieRecord elements in the records list to be non-null to avoid NPEs during processing.
